description: Auto-synthesized methodology for: HTTP Protocol Error Handling

storage.description: A systematic approach to detecting, classifying, logging, and recovering from HTTP protocol errors to maintain reliable communication between clients and servers.
storage.name: HTTP Protocol Error Handling
principles: Detect errors early using status code inspection
Classify errors by client vs server and idempotency
Log detailed error context for diagnostics
Implement graceful degradation and retry strategies
Standardize error responses per RFC specifications
